executor: Codex implementation and independent gate re-verification

scope.policy: One shared loopback-origin validator for final merged configuration and runtime commands; no production opt-in flag
scope.requests: Exact configured origins only; automatic redirects disabled and redirect responses refused
scope.browser_middleware: Root suite and per-test refusals before other intercept handlers
scope.accounts: No embedded account defaults; explicit disposable inputs required and auth request/UI inputs hidden from command logs

mutation_probe.scope: private copy with origin refusal deliberately disabled

retained_failed_attempts: Jest initially claimed the Node-only .test.cjs file and reported that it contained no Jest tests. Renamed to .check.cjs; both independent runners then passed. No Jest ignore or gate bypass was added.

The first private browser proof parsed attempt.error instead of the documented test.displayError. Correct refusals appeared in the log but the proof failed. Fixed parsing without relaxing refusal counts, messages or the sentinel assertion; portable proof passed.

An optional full-graph audit refresh exceeded its 45-second local process cap. It was not counted as passed. The required production audit passed; development dependency remediation remains in held review 300.

ci: Exact review head must pass all maintained jobs, build and release guard; links are recorded in the review
limits: No legacy application journeys executed; fixtures exercised guard modules only

Arbitrary custom configs, Node tasks, plugins and server-side app traffic are not an OS-level network fence
